whatsNew:
• Your Bluetooth adapter now connects by itself, and reconnects when it drops, with no trip to the Bluetooth MIDI screen each time.
• Over Bluetooth or USB: Edit chain moves, adds and removes blocks; rename presets and scenes; the looper, modifiers, cab picker and the unit's own metronome click.
• AM4 firmware 3.00: the NAM block, with TONE3000 captures, and the Pitch block.
• Hold the Amp on Play to swap it for a NAM block.
• Clear this preset, in Edit chain, to start fresh.
• A clear progress bar while a capture is sent to your unit.
• Many Bluetooth fixes.
notesNew:
New in 2.3.5:
• Bluetooth: after an adapter is chosen once in Apple's Bluetooth MIDI screen, the app connects it itself (CoreBluetooth, in the foreground only, no background mode) and again when it drops. Needs a real adapter; the demo has no Bluetooth.
• Over Bluetooth or USB, with a unit: Edit chain moves, adds and removes blocks; Rename; Copy channel; looper buttons; modifiers; cab picker; the unit's metronome click; an FM3's Footswitches page.
• AM4: its NAM and Pitch blocks, with TONE3000 as on an Axe-Fx III.
• Hold the Amp on Play: Swap for a NAM block.
• Edit chain: Clear this preset.
• The independent-app card shows on the first launch only.
testedOn: Tested on: iPhone 17 Pro Max, iOS 27.2.1; Apple Watch Ultra 2.
